tasks.summary: I fixed the S6.audit finding for S6.report, and all 11 acceptance commands pass. The report and its template no longer say Access report layouts and report-level totals are "proven by" the S5 view, rule and end-to-end tests. They now say "checked by the S5 view tests (test_views.py), rule tests and end-to-end tests (not compared with Access), not by goldens (...)". The Coverage column "Proven by" is now "Checked by". I searched toolkit/report.py and the template for any other prove/proven/proof/same-results claim and found none left. A new test, test_report_and_template_never_say_proven, fails if the template, the fixed coverage sentence or the generated report uses any form of prove/proof or "same results", and it checks the new sentence and the "Checked by" column. Test results: 37 of 37 report and purge tests pass, and ruff is clean. I re-ran the whole matrix: 8 cells, 428 of 428 passed, so the lowest cell rate is 1.0, pooled 1.0 and coverage-adjusted 0.9907. The app tests passed on PostgreSQL (864, end-to-end included) and on SQL Server (859, without end-to-end). The results summary has 11 cells: 157 of 157 rule tests pass on each database and 5 of 5 end-to-end tests on PostgreSQL. results.json came out byte-identical to the last version. In the report only the two reworded lines changed; --check passes and all 8 headings are there. The purge dry-run lists 5 databases and 3385 files under private (about 80.6 MB), finds no Windows-box copies to list, and deletes nothing. Guard reports 0 failures across 1114 files.
notes: Departure from the build spec, as the operator asked: the fixed Access report-coverage sentence in templates/docs/equivalence-report.md and in report.py's REPORT_COVERAGE_SENTENCE now reads 'checked by ... (not compared with Access), not by goldens (...)' instead of 'proven by'. The S0/S6 build spec text still holds the old wording and should be updated to match.

The audit's other two blocking findings, (2) root NOTICE.md/README/LICENSE (S6.handover) and (3) the CR LF caption in frmproductdetail.svg (S6.visuals), are outside this task's owned paths and I did not touch them. The pipeline working tree also has uncommitted changes in toolkit/wireframe.py and toolkit/tests/test_wireframe.py, which belong to S6.visuals.

The mp-data equivalence summary has a message 'mssql: server did not answer (ConnectionStringParseError); left to the command'. This comes from mp-data's own pre-check. All 4 SQL Server cells still ran and passed (54/52/54/54), so the pre-check's handling of mssql:// URLs probably needs a look in mp-data. It did not affect the results.
results.json came out byte-identical to the previous attempt's file (same counts and date). known-differences.json keeps an empty entries list because every compared output passed in every cell.
The purge dry-run lists no environment.windows_box.copies entries (copies: 0) because the engagement records none.

tasks.summary: I fixed the S6.audit finding (3). Label and command-button captions that contain line breaks (CR LF, CR or LF) are now drawn as one <text> with one <tspan> per line. Before, the CR LF went raw into the <text> element. Every other text node in the SVG (control names, tab captions, section titles) now has line breaks and control characters turned into spaces. Indentation whitespace is stripped inside multi-line <text> elements. I added a test for the three line-break forms. It checks that the output has no CR, that no <text> or <tspan> holds a raw line break, that the lines come out as separate tspans, and that the output does not change under eol=lf normalisation. I regenerated the 13 Northwind wireframes and the index; frmproductdetail.svg now uses tspans. No file under docs/img/before contains a CR any more, and git check-attr reports eol=lf, so normalisation is a no-op and --check will pass on a fresh checkout. The 19 tests pass and all 8 acceptance commands exit 0, including --check and the guard.
notes: Fix for S6.audit item (3): a caption with line breaks is drawn as a <text> holding one <tspan> per line, each with its own x and y. A line is 13 px high and the lines are centred on the control. Any other text drops CR, LF and control characters as spaces (one_line in _el).

Checked by grep: no file under docs/img/before contains a CR byte, and the target's .gitattributes gives these files eol=lf. git normalisation therefore leaves the bytes unchanged, and wireframe --check passes on a fresh checkout.
Only frmproductdetail.svg changed in the target on regeneration (written: 1); the other 12 SVGs and index.md are byte-identical.

issues.problem: The lens requires xpass, missing tests and -k runs to count as not passed. toolkit/results.py cannot do that for two cases. First, outcome() returns 'passed' for any testcase with no failure, error or skipped child, and pytest's JUnit writes a non-strict XPASS exactly that way, so an xpass counts as passed. Second, report.py checks cell totals against |C_d| only for equivalence cells. The rules and e2e cells have no expected count, so a narrowed app run (-k or deselect) would still show 100% as long as the tests that ran passed. Today's numbers are not affected: there are no xfail markers in the app or harness, and both app JUnit files show skipped=0, failures=0, errors=0 with tests=864 (PostgreSQL) and 859 (SQL Server).
